meaning:
προ-ετοιμάζω
[in LXX: Isa.28:24 B, Wis.9:8 * ;]
to prepare before: with accusative of thing(s), Rom.9:23 (οἱς for ἅ by attraction), Eph.2:10.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory,
For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
